browser.note: The directory named web-initial passed on its first run and is the final-build evidence; no replacement result was needed. Browser screenshots advance frames, so their sampled frame is not an exact image timestamp.

visual.result: Original style orange Crackle and separate fire jets are visible in the actual mixed generated room in native and WASM captures.
